text:
alex: FYI CI turned red after the toolchain image roll (gcc/clang bump). CMake ASAN link error on multiple targets. anyone on triage?

alex: failing target //cc/lib/redis:redis_client (macOS-asan, linux-asan flaky). quick log: 
```
Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
  "__asan_region_is_poisoned", referenced from:
      __asan_report_load1 in libredis.a(redis.o)
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
clang-12: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```

maria: hmm, saw a couple flakes earlier but not full link errors. which image was rolled?

alex: rolling image: infra/gcc-clang:2026-03-10 (clang-15 default) - previously clang-12 in last stable. CMake 3.26.1 unchanged.

sam: :eyes: can you paste the full linker command that the CI printed? cc flags, sanitizer flags?

alex: pasted minimal invocation from build log: 
```
/usr/bin/clang++ -fsanitize=address -shared -o libredis.dylib redis.o -L/opt/asan/lib -lasan -L/usr/local/lib -lstdc++ -Wl,-dead_strip
```

liam: interesting - looks like asan runtime symbols unresolved (maybe different asan runtime ABI between compiler and libasan used). could be that the image now ships a different asan and the linker is picking system lib.

infra-oncall: starting triage. tagging infra-owners. @maria @liam can you verify mac builder image has matching libasan? I can kick a rerun with debug flags.

maria: checking image now. if the image has clang-15 but our base distro still supplies libasan from older libc package that could mismatch. also check RPATH ordering.

devops-bot: CI rerun scheduled: https://ci.internal.redwood/2620109876 (button: rerun with debug).

sam: quick try: add explicit -Wl,-rpath,/opt/asan/lib and ensure -lasan before -lstdc++ to prefer bundled runtime. anyone want me to push a ephemeral patch?

alex: can we avoid patching product code? if this is just image mismatch we should fix image or revert. but for a hotfix to unblock CI a small CMake change to set LINK_FLAGS for that target might be OK.

liam: agree revert image to previous working tag is safest short term. opening rollback PR now.

maria: found image contents: /opt/asan/lib/libasan.dylib (version header says clang 14 build). so mismatch with clang-15 toolchain. that explains undefined link symbol names.

alex: ok we should roll image back. can infra push rollback and then we can re-run CI?

infra-oncall: rolling back infra/gcc-clang to 2026-02-28-tag now. will post when done. ETA ~10m.

devops-bot: infra image rollback deployed (2026-03-12T14:22Z). triggering CI reruns for failing pipelines.

sam: re-run kicked. if it still fails, post full link command and I’ll try the temporary rpath patch in a PR.

alex: rerun green on linux-asan, mac-asan is now queued.

liam: note for follow-up: we need an image validation e2e that links a small ASAN binary and verifies symbols match for new toolchain images. filing infra ticket.

maria: +1, also add a smoke step in CMake to check that -fsanitize=address links.

alex: thanks all. bookmarking the rollback PR and infra ticket. if mac run finishes green i'll close the triage. :thumbsup:

infra-oncall: mac run passed. closing incident. summary: toolchain image shipped mismatched libasan runtime (clang-15 vs libasan built for clang-14). action items: image validation e2e, document toolchain-runtime compatibility checklist.
